# Answer — BL-766

BL-766: Option B.

Keep Mini App Let's Talk as the live contract for now. Revert the half-done
test and doc rewrite in the working tree. Restore the CRAP gate so it still
covers every Let's Talk surface the bridge still serves. Do not finish Mini
App retirement in this ticket.

Full Bubble cutover and Mini App removal can wait for the later port intakes
already filed. Approve BL-766 on that Option B posture.
